title: A phone number read in three, three and four digits with pauses between groups

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Thank you for calling. How can I help you today?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Hello, I'd like to update the phone number you have on file for me.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Certainly. Please read me the new number, and I will read it back to you afterwards.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: It's four one five <1.3s> five five five <1.4s> zero one two three.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Four one five, five five five, zero one two three. Is that right?

items.speaker: caller
items.text: That's right. And can you also add a second number, <1.2s> for my partner?

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Of course, go ahead whenever you are ready.

items.speaker: caller
items.text: Six one seven <1.5s> five five five <1.1s> nine two one zero.

items.speaker: agent
items.text: Six one seven, five five five, nine two one zero. Both numbers are saved now. Is there anything else?
